mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are looking at clear skies and 45 degrees by the Verona Public Library under a first quarter moon. Expect an overnight low of 40 with no rain predicted for the rest of the night.

The Verona Police Department recently arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving on Thursday. Meanwhile, the city is reminding residents to use the interactive map on the city website to locate their specific zoning district and polling place.

There is plenty to do in our area today, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can find yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19, followed by trivia nights starting October 20 at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On Thursday, officers took a school bus driver into custody for O W I. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating whether the vehicle struck any traffic signs.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
